definitions.explanation: A building or section of a hospital where patients are housed, typically organized by medical specialty or patient type.

examples.japanese: {病棟|びょうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go visit someone in the hospital ward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{病棟|びょうとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The new hospital ward is scheduled to be completed next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{病棟|びょうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隔離|かくり}→隔離：14532_kakuri⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Patients with infectious diseases are isolated in a dedicated ward.

notes:
Refers to the physical building or wing of a hospital where inpatients stay. Japanese hospitals are often organized into multiple {病棟|びょうとう}, each specializing in different areas of care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧{病棟|びょうとう}: inpatient ward
- ⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧{病棟|びょうとう}: outpatient wing
- ⟦{小児|しょうに}→小児：27025_shouni⟧{病棟|びょうとう}: pediatric ward
- ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧{病棟|びょうとう}: psychiatric ward
- ⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧{病棟|びょうとう}: closed ward (locked psychiatric unit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病室|びょうしつ}→病室：21074_byoushitsu⟧: hospital room — a single room within a ward
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospital — the entire medical facility
- ⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧: clinic — a smaller medical facility, typically without inpatient beds
